entities.name: EMM-DEREGISTERED.NO-CELL-AVAILABLE
entities.description: Substate entered when no E-UTRAN cell can be selected after intensive search fails in EMM-DEREGISTERED.PLMN-SEARCH. Cells are searched at low rhythm and no EPS services are offered.

entities.name: EMM-DEREGISTERED.PLMN-SEARCH
entities.description: Previous substate where intensive cell search was performed before transitioning to NO-CELL-AVAILABLE state.

entities.name: No E-UTRAN cell can be selected
entities.description: Condition where UE cannot select any E-UTRAN cell after intensive search.

entities.name: No EPS services offered
entities.description: System behavior where EPS services are not available to the UE in this state.

entities.name: Cells searched at low rhythm
entities.description: System behavior where UE performs cell search operations at reduced frequency.

relations.description: Condition of no E-UTRAN cell being selected establishes transition to NO-CELL-AVAILABLE state.
State transition from PLMN-SEARCH to NO-CELL-AVAILABLE after intensive search fails.
Being in NO-CELL-AVAILABLE state establishes that no EPS services are offered.
Being in NO-CELL-AVAILABLE state establishes that cells are searched at low rhythm.
